question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**until**" is used to indicate the point in time at which a specified event or condition ends. In this context,** "until" **correctly conveys the gradual disappearance of the ship from view.
 
• **"Since"** is incorrect because it indicates a starting point in time, not a continuation up to a point.
 
• **"By the time"** is not suitable here as it suggests completion by a specific time.
 
• **"After"** is incorrect because it indicates a subsequent point in time, not a continuous process.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The bottom of the ship disappears first, and then the ship seems to sink lower and lower, until__ we can only see the top of the ship, and then we see nothing at all.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Since (से)**: Indicates the starting point of an action.
 
• **Until (तक)**: Indicates the continuation of an action up to a point in time.
 
• **By the time (समय तक)**: Indicates an action completed by a certain time.
 
• **After (के बाद)**: Indicates a subsequent event.
